mos_terminal_order.meaning: nodes of a type M component are [drain, gate, source, bulk]
mos_terminal_order.sca_main_lines: 9069 stampMOS(Drain, Gate, Source, Bulk, ...); 9270-9272 called with pins{1..4}; 8258 add_mos pins = {D,G,S,B}

vccs.meaning: nodes of a type VCCS component are [output p, output n, control pc, control nc]
vccs.current: I = g*(V(pc) - V(nc)) flows from node p through the source to node n
vccs.sca_main_lines: 8001 pins = [out_nodes, ctrl_nodes]; 9046 stampVCCS(p, n, pc, nc, g, G); 9253-9257 called with pins{1..4}; 9054 G(p,pc) += g; 9060 G(n,pc) -= g

voltage_source.branch_current: I flows from node plus through the source to node minus: +I in the KCL row of plus, -I in the row of minus
voltage_source.sca_main_lines: 8979 G(nplus,row) += 1; 8983 G(nminus,row) -= 1; 8980/8984 constraint row; 8986 B(row) = amp

kcl_rows.rule: node row k of (G + s*C)*x = B: sum of the currents leaving node k through the elements = B(k), the current injected into node k by independent current sources
kcl_rows.sca_main_lines: 8919-8928 stampR: G(n1,n1) += 1/R, G(n1,n2) -= 1/R; 9110-9116 stampI: B(nplus) -= amp, B(nminus) += amp
